user.title: Connect to TVBalance
user.description: Enter the address of your TVBalance Engine (default port 8765).

hassio_confirm.title: Set up TVBalance
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the TVBalance Add-on found at its Home Assistant address?

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to TVBalance again
reauth_confirm.description: The Engine at {url} no longer accepts the API token. Create a new token in the TVBalance web app and enter it here.

tls_confirm.title: Trust the TVBalance certificate

error.invalid_auth: The Engine rejected the API token.
error.invalid_response: The server answered, but it does not look like a TVBalance Engine.
error.untrusted_certificate: The certificate of this Engine is not trusted, and it has no local authority to trust. Use a certificate that Home Assistant already trusts, or turn on the automatic one.

abort.reauth_successful: The new API token is working.
abort.invalid_discovery: The TVBalance information is not valid.

bonus.name: Grant extra time
bonus.description: Adds minutes to today's budget. Needs a Home Assistant administrator.

allow.name: Allow the TV
allow.description: Allows the TV regardless of the rules for a while. Needs a Home Assistant administrator.

until_midnight.name: Until midnight
until_midnight.description: Last until midnight instead of a number of minutes.

block.name: Block the TV
block.description: Blocks the TV regardless of the rules for a while. Needs a Home Assistant administrator.

until_midnight.name: Until midnight
until_midnight.description: Last until midnight instead of a number of minutes.

pause.name: Pause rules
pause.description: Stops enforcement for a while. Needs a Home Assistant administrator.

clear_override.name: Back to the rules
clear_override.description: Cancels an active allow, block or pause. Needs a Home Assistant administrator.

set_monitoring.name: Switch monitoring
set_monitoring.description: Turns monitoring of the TV on or off. Needs a Home Assistant administrator and an API token with the Administer scope.

activate_profile.name: Activate profile
activate_profile.description: Puts a rule set in force for every TV in the household. Needs a Home Assistant administrator and the Pro plan.

policy_id.name: Rule set ID
policy_id.description: The number of the rule set, shown in the Engine's address bar when you edit it.

until_midnight.name: Until midnight
until_midnight.description: Keep it on until the household's midnight.

excluded_device_ids.name: TVs to leave out
excluded_device_ids.description: These TVs keep following their own rules.

stop_profile.name: Stop profile
stop_profile.description: Ends the profile now. Needs a Home Assistant administrator.

unknown_device.message: This device is not a TVBalance TV.

entry_not_loaded.message: The TVBalance integration for this TV is not loaded.

choose_one_duration.message: Give either minutes or until midnight, not both and not neither.

not_allowed.message: The Engine refused this action: {error}. Check that the API token has the needed scope (Administer is needed to switch monitoring).

engine_error.message: The TVBalance Engine reported a problem: {error}
